section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1973
title: ## Distribution of Suicides by Age Out of the total suicides reported, 45·1 per cent were committed by the people belonging to the age group of 18 to 30 years; 29·8 per cent belonged to 30 to 50 years age-group, 16·4 per cent belonged to the age group below 18 years and 8·6 per cent belonged above 50 years age group. The all India pattern of suicide according to age group was almost similar to that of states and union territories. The detailed statistics are given in Table 6. TABLE 6
